topic: Aerodynamic loading distribution, span wise and chord wise distribution, effects of sweep and distribution.
syllabus_extract: Aerodynamic loading distribution, span wise and chord wise distribution, effects of sweep and distribution.
specific_objectives: 11.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain aircraft structure, various structural elements and their details.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Review of wing structural elements and load paths using models; Instructor supervision required for model handling.
intro_questions: What are the primary forces acting on an aircraft wing?
List the main structural elements of a wing.

topics: Effect of wing sweep on loads
development.content:
Definition of aerodynamic loading
Span wise load distribution
Chord wise load distribution
Effect of wing sweep on loads

Structural response to span loads
Structural response to chord loads
Sweep effects on bending moments
Sweep effects on torsional loads

Combined loading scenarios
Load factor implications
Design considerations for sweep
Summary of distribution effects

summary_questions: Explain how wing sweep affects the chord wise load distribution.
Describe the relationship between span wise loading and structural elements.
Differentiate between bending and torsional loads caused by sweep.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on how the loading distribution principles discussed in this lesson apply to the miscellaneous loading cases covered in LP 08.

pft_rows.syllabus: Miscellaneous loading cases, longitudinal cases, fuselage pressurization loads, flap and airbrake loads, spinning and power plants load, fuel systems, freight loads, ground handling guided missile launcher cases.
